catalogue.note: Figma draws this frame at 58×125, but its content is a 375-wide design scaled by 58.0037/375: multiplied by 6.46511 the type lands on 14, 16, 18, 23, 28 and 33px, the paddings on 24 and 32, the buttons on 327×56. Built at 375×808 (the frame is 374.98×808.14; the design under it is 375×812, cut at the frame). Square-cornered: the artboard’s corner radius and grey outline are left off, and the diff leaves out that ring and the four corners (6368 pixels). Boxes sit where the Plugin API resolved them; icons and shapes are Figma’s SVG export, unchanged. Type is live: Satoshi and Roboto from the files on this Mac, embedded whole. Each string’s first baseline and line height come from Figma’s own outline and text box, because at 58px wide Figma snaps every line to a whole pixel (6.47px here); all strings land within 0.5px. The Pixel status bar is the one part drawn on a different base (371.2 wide), kept at Figma’s size. Diff is against Figma’s 4× PNG export (232×500), the build captured at 2× and resampled; against Figma’s SVG export at full size it is 1.74%. Figma stacks two action panels here, 1px apart; the lower one (terms line and a dimmed Next) is fully covered by the keyboard panel, so only its background is built. The keys’ shadows come out a little heavier than in Figma’s PNG: they are Figma’s SVG filter, drawn by the browser.
